title: [v0.93.1] Make legacy prompt interpolation deterministic
summary: Make legacy prompt interpolation deterministic by substituting only original template placeholders and treating inserted values literally.
non_goals_inline: No recursive template evaluation, Runtime implementation changes, provider calls, broad tests, main writes, or shared binary replacement.
dependencies_inline: Independent external preflight P2 reproduction at frozen f75f0d3; corrective issue1288.
repo_inputs_inline: adl-legacy-contracts/src/prompt.rs; retained_contract_edges prompt test; public CLI workflow_display caller; independent prompt-determinism-result.json.
target_files_surfaces_inline: adl-legacy-contracts/src/prompt.rs and narrowly coupled prompt contract documentation if needed.
deliverables_inline: Deterministic literal-value interpolation; focused regression proof; independently reviewed PR with required CI.
validation_plan_inline: Focused cargo prompt unit tests via native proof, focused formatting, regression against old exact function; existing required CI only. PVF local deterministic contract, small CPU/filesystem, no provider calls.
acceptance_criteria_inline: Order-independent output, literal nested-looking values, preserved missing/repeated/Unicode substitutions and role order; regression fails old implementation; native proof and independent review pass.
notes_risks_inline: No recursive expansion contract found; tests currently preserve unknown placeholders. Tests and build outputs stay on FastWork. Preserve release baseline adverse evidence; final candidate freeze must include corrective merge.
